subject: DPA negotiation, SCCs & DPIA inquiry — NewCo Health
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire.h@newco.health>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@newco.health, legal+privacy@newco.health
Date: 2027-04-03T16:12:00Z
Subject: DPA + SCCs + DPIA question for Redwood (NewCo Health)

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — NewCo is excited about the latency numbers and the model routing options. Procurement asked me to reach out on the privacy side to get a DPA in place before we progress to a PO. A few items on our side: 

- Can Redwood accept the EU SCCs (modules 1->2) for processor transfers?
- We need a copy of a completed DPIA or confirmation that Redwood will support our DPIA template (attached).
- Please share the SOC 2 evidence bundle or attestations you can provide during procurement review.

Can you share next steps and timeline? We're targetting a May 1 start, so it'd be helpful to understand how quickly we can iterate the DPA and get a countersigned copy.

Thanks,
Claire Hammond
Head of Procurement — NewCo Health
(attachment: NewCo_DPIA_template.docx, 46KB)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Claire Hammond <claire.h@newco.health>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-03T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: DPA + SCCs + DPIA question for Redwood (NewCo Health)

Hi Claire — great to hear, and thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and plan: 

- SCCs: We accept the EU SCCs for controller->processor transfers; we typically apply Module 2 when customers require onward transfer protections. I'll confirm exact module mapping with legal, but yes we can support the SCCs you referenced.
- DPIA: We don't pre-complete customer DPIAs, but we provide the artifacts your team needs (data flows, subprocessors list, DPIA inputs). If your template has specific questions, send it over and we'll return the completed sections we own.
- SOC 2: I'll attach the SOC 2 Type II summary and gap statement; full evidence packages require an NDA/secure share — we can provision a temporary access link for procurement.

I've attached an initial redline to the standard Redwood DPA (see NewCo_DPA_redline_Aditya_20270402.pdf) and an SCCs mapping sheet. Laura — would you and Rishi review the redline and flag anything that needs exec approval (eg. retention exceptions, subprocessor carveouts)?

Claire — proposed next steps:
1) Legal redline review (internal) — 48h
2) Send consolidated redline back to you for counter-redline — 24–48h
3) If acceptable, we route for signature via DocuSign and notify CSM for onboarding.

If May 1 is the target, we should be able to hit that if reviews move quickly.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: NewCo_DPA_redline_Aditya_20270402.pdf, 72KB)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-04T09:18:00Z
Subject: RE: DPA + SCCs + DPIA question for Redwood (NewCo Health)

Aditya — thanks for the draft. Quick notes after an initial pass: 

- Retention: NewCo is asking for a custom retention clause (longer than our standard 24 months). We'll push back and offer a narrow carveout (audit copies for 36 months only if justified). That one will need exec sign-off if they insist.
- SCCs: We can accept Module 2 for the specific processors they named, but we need Procurement to confirm the list of recipients; ask Claire to enumerate recipients.
- DPIA: we can fill their template sections relating to Redwood processing. I'll prepare the DPIA response package (data flow diagram, subprocessors list, security controls summary).

I've attached my annotated redline and the SCCs mapping workbook — see comments on retention (Tab 3) and subprocessor disclosure (Tab 1).

Next actions for us: 
- Rishi, please confirm whether the retention exception requires a CSO/Legal exec approval or whether Product can sign off under our SLA policy.
- Aditya, ask Claire for the recipient list for SCCs and confirm whether they need HIPAA-specific language (they're healthcare, so might be requesting BAAs or HIPAA SRA language).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference
(attachment: NewCo_DPA_redline_Aditya_20270402.pdf, annotated; SCCs_mapping_NewCo.xlsx)

Thanks, Aditya — appreciating the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement and legal: 

- Downstream recipients: we will be transferring data to an analytics partner (Carelytics) and a US data lake (us-east-1). We've added Carelytics to the attached subprocessor list.
- HIPAA: we do require HIPAA-compliant assurances for the processing relevant to patient health identifiers. If Redwood can confirm support for HIPAA controls (or provide a BAA addendum), that will speed things up.
- DPIA: we'll accept the Redwood-provided DPIA inputs. Please send the data flow diagram and subprocessors list.

Given these asks, procurement is asking whether Redwood can accept the retention wording in our redline for audit copies (36 months) — otherwise they may need a contract amendment later. Please let us know the position by EOD Tuesday so we can keep the May 1 start.

Claire
(attachment: NewCo_subprocessor_list_v2.xlsx)

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: claire.h@newco.health
Date: 2027-04-06T22:34:00Z
Subject: RE: DPA + SCCs + DPIA question for Redwood (NewCo Health) — routing and sign plan

Laura/Rishi — outcome and ask: 

- HIPAA: Procurement requires BAA language. Laura, can we provide a BAA addendum for the modules touching PHI? If yes, I'll propose that to Claire as an appendix rather than changing the core DPA.
- Retention: recommend we hold firm at 24 months for standard logs, offer a narrow audit-copy exception to 36 months with documented justification. That keeps risk bounded and avoids exec escalation unless NewCo insists.
- SCCs: fine to accept Module 2 for the named downstream recipients (Carelytics + US data lake). Procurement requested the explicit recipient list — we've received it from Claire.

If you approve, plan for routing: 
1) Finalize consolidated DPA + BAA appendix (Legal) — 24h
2) Send consolidated doc to NewCo for final review — 24h
3) DocuSign routing to Claire/procurement once countersigned — procurement signs, then Redwood exec signs (CSO or General Counsel depending on retention exception), then copy to CSM for onboarding.

Related items to include in DocuSign envelope: redline PDF, SCCs mapping workbook, DPIA inputs (data flow diagram). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/ND-8721.

If you want, I can schedule the 30-minute call with Claire and Laura for tomorrow.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachments: NewCo_DPA_redline_Aditya_20270402.pdf; SCCs_mapping_NewCo.xlsx)
